description: For a past men's tournament (2016-2026; no tournament was played in 2020), returns the winning recipes: the site's own five-question engine was run over that year's REAL field (real teams, real seeds) across 108 answer combinations, and every bracket was scored against what actually happened under standard pool scoring (1-2-4-8-16-32, max 192). With no style inputs, returns the year's real champion and Final Four, the best total score and the recipe that earned it, the best first-weekend score, how many recipes ended with the real champion, and how many reproduced the full Final Four (in most years, none did). With style inputs (chaos, tiebreak, champion_pick, loyalty), scores that exact recipe instead. Counted history, not a prediction: a recipe is what WOULD have scored in a finished tournament, and the result says so. No odds, no betting advice.

champion_pick.description: Optional recipe input: one of that year's real Final Four teams, or 'none'.

loyalty.description: Optional recipe input: 'none' or 'home' (root for the champion pick as your home team).

title: Get backtested winning recipes
